about_the_game:
Already own Killing Floor 3?

You can can elevate your game with the Shadow Agent Season 1 Deluxe Pass, a DLC pack that includes instant access to:

  • Shadow Agents Weapon Skin: An equipable cosmetic for your weapons, available in the Armory

  • Shadow Agents Outfit and Head cosmetic skins: Equipable within the Stronghold for each of the 6 initial Specialists

  • Premium Access to the Season 1 Nightfall Supply Pass, available at launch

  • 1000 Extra Creds

The Supply Pass in Killing Floor 3 is a tiered, in-game progression system that offers cosmetic rewards. Players advance through the Supply Pass by earning Supply Pass Reward Points from completing gameplay objectives. These points allow them to unlock various cosmetic items, including new character outfits, weapon skins, weapon trinkets, and more which are displayed on a dedicated progression track for both premium and free access users. Supply Passes do not have an expiration date, allowing players to progress at their own pace.

Creds are in-game currency that can be used within Killing Floor 3 to obtain in-game content in the Item Store as well as Premium Access to available Nightfall Supply Passes not already obtained.
